visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white wide-brimmed hat and a white sweatshirt, holds a microphone and smiles excitedly at the camera in a modern, minimalist indoor space with warm lighting and a white sofa. (2) The scene cuts to a wide shot of a bright room where a crowd of young women is seated at tables, waving at the camera; a digital spreadsheet overlay showing budget numbers and data appears over the frame. (3) Close-up shots of a laptop screen displaying rows of participant information in a spreadsheet, followed by the main character interacting closely with fans, including group photos and warm embraces. (4) A series of quick cuts shows the participants in various activities: sitting in a group reading books intently, participating in high-energy team games involving stacking hands, and the main character walking through the room in a pink top while being greeted with applause. (5) An outdoor shot at sunset shows the entire group standing on a sidewalk near a parking area, waving enthusiastically towards the camera; the lighting is natural and golden. (6) The main character is seen back indoors, visibly emotional and holding a bouquet of white flowers and a small blue decorative cake while addressing the audience; she wipes tears with a tissue. (7) The video concludes with static screenshots of social media profiles for 'Blaire Chen' across different platforms.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 有人問. (2) [Slogan]: 花20萬辦粉絲見面會值得嗎? [Subtitle]: 為什麼千人報名. (3) [Subtitle]: 卻每場只抽了30個左右的人? [Variety]: 睽違五年. (4) [Subtitle]: 終於能與小暖們面對面聊天. (5) [Subtitle]: 分了三場, 人數不到百人. (6) [Subtitle]: 只為了讓大家能做更深度交流. (7) [Variety]: 小巧而精緻, 細節也不馬虎. (8) [Subtitle]: 從佈置、桌牌、餐點、破冰遊戲, 到氣質的讀書會. (9) [Variety]: 瘋狂的團隊遊戲. (10) [Subtitle]: 個人的鐵粉競賽. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有現場版碎碎念. (12) [Slogan]: 諮商心理師. [Subtitle]: 與超~棒的特別來賓加持. (13) [Variety]: 最後還有能量超強的集體顯化環節. (14) [Subtitle]: 緊湊的活動讓大家都滿載而歸. (15) [Slogan]: Blaire 生日快樂. [Subtitle]: 網絡世界的不友善. (16) [Subtitle]: 讓我更珍惜這群人的存在. (17) [Subtitle]: 聽到你們突破圈層, 想要與新朋友續攤. (18) [Subtitle]: 收到你們滿到不行的感動與行動方案. (19) [Subtitle]: 看到你們的笑容和眼眶裡打轉的淚水. (20) [Variety]: 嗯, 值得! [Subtitle]: 扶持的力量是互相的. (21) [Subtitle]: 不只是現場這100人, 還是報名的這1000人. (22) [Subtitle]: 而是這一路支持我的每一個人. (23) [Subtitle]: 想對你們送上最誠摯的感謝. (24) [Slogan]: 有你們才有今天的Blaire. [Logo]: @blairechen. @blairechen_. @beblaire.
